notes.title: What Comes Next Demo Release
notes.notes:
We at Dandelion Developers have been working on another game during our final year of University! As you all know, during August of 2024 we released our side-project Haunting Memories and even though it was a fun learning experience we set our eyes forward on a new project!

What Comes Next was born and we have been working on this for the past six months as another side-project outside of school. We are very happy to say that our demo for What Comes Next was just released!

Play the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3539780/What_Comes_Next_Demo/

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 is out!
notes.notes: We've seen some players struggle with the puzzle in the Office. So we added a little hint that hopefully will help players progress through that part of the game!
